name: gizza-ai/unzip
summary: Extract the files from a .zip archive.

tool.description: Extract the files from a .zip archive and return them individually. Each regular file is listed with its path and size, and its content inline — as text when it is UTF-8, otherwise as base64. (Large files past an internal budget are listed without content.) Provide the zip as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref. Runs locally — the archive never leaves the device.

url.description: File URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.
